title: GitLab CI adoption detection: reliable signals (don’t rely on ci_config_path)
summary: For CI adoption scanning, prefer pipeline existence and .gitlab-ci.yml presence on the default branch; ci_config_path can be null despite working pipelines.
heuristic: Resolve project id and default branch.
If GET /projects/:id/pipelines returns >= 1 pipeline -> CI active.
Else if .gitlab-ci.yml exists on default branch -> CI configured.
Else -> CI not detected (or insufficient permissions).
failure_modes: ci_config_path may be null/empty even when pipelines exist
default_branch differs across repos (main vs master)
private projects may hide pipelines/config from unauthenticated requests
